Installing the package name from npm,"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" or installing the workspace root directly, does **not** install this GitHub-only prerelease."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What changed"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Native conversation tabs:** use the sidebar's add/guide entry, “新建侧聊”, to open an independent bl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ank page. Multiple child conversations can be open at once.
- **Deferred child creation:** opening a"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"n empty page does not create a Session. Its first send creates the child; adding a file also creates"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" the child needed for an upload receipt, without sending a prompt.
- **Separate drafts and history:*"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"* each tab addresses only its own child. Reopen saved conversations from the blank page. Closing a t"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ab does not cancel, archive or delete its Session.
- **Child controls:** Host catalog-backed model/p"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ermission choices, child questions and approval decisions, plus explicit cancellation of generation."},{"id":"p14s8","text":"
- **Web attachments:** upload, drag-and-drop or paste supported clipboard images; see progress, rem"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ove files or retry. File receipts stay child-scoped; images use native image content. Attachment-onl"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"y messages are supported.
- **No automatic write-back:** side-chat messages are not appended to the "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"parent. A model selection does not rewrite the existing parent Session, but the Host may save it as "},{"id":"p14s12","text":"the default for subsequently created unconfigured Sessions."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Interface copy is currently Chinese. Attachment admission is at most 10 files and 20 MB per file; th"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e Host may enforce stricter limits. Unsent files remain in memory during tab navigation, **not acros"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s browser reloads**. Annotations and answer return are development-only, not accepted runtime featur"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"es in this prerelease."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Permissions and retained data"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**This rewrite is not an always-read-only child agent.** It uses the Host's child-session model, per"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"mission presets and approval flow. Review the child's selected permissions before sending a prompt; "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"the legacy fixed tool allowlist/deny guard is not carried over. Full-access/automatic presets requir"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e the Host's risk-acknowledgement path."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Tabs are a UI lifetime, not a data-erasure boundary. Closing a tab does not end its child or erase i"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ts persisted history. There is no v0.4-style automatic 30-minute parked expiry. The old metadata mod"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"el is not automatically imported.
